notes.title: Update 2.1 Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]💢The Ripatorium[/b][/h1][h3][b]😌Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Player’s selection of equipped guns, upgrades, melee weapon, and shield rune will now persist once adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Added ammo and health pickups to Ripatorium arenas[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐞Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the crash issue during combat with too many enemy AI present in the Ripatorium as well as in the campaign [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with the base Vagary not dying when executed while dazed [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Champion Vagary had a chance to spawn when the base Vagary was selected [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where swapping any Shield Rune after starting the arena would cause some of the upgrades to no longer work, including Steadfast, Harvester, Blade Master, and Retaliation [/p][/*][*][p]The Steadfast Shield upgrade now functions when an unbroken shield is restoring health [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where multiple upgrades where being applied at the same time for Accelerator and Shredder [/p][/*][/list][h1][b]👿Enemy AI[/b][/h1][quote][p][i]General gameplay balance refinements (some of these were previously Active Tunables that have been removed from that article and committed to the game in Update 2.1 Hotfix 1). These are denoted below as: (*PT) for "Previous Tunable"[/i][/p][/quote][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where Imp, Soldier, Zombie, and Arachnotron’s swipe melee attacks dealt no damage if passing through other demons first [/p][/*][*][p]Armored enemies will now falter when their armor is destroyed with Shotguns [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Vagary did not falter after taking damage from the Dreadmace direct damage or AOE damage once certain upgrades had been purchased [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Pinky Rider Armor prevented falters from the Slayer’s landing impact [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Whiplash did not perform a falter from the Slayer’s landing impact   [/p][/*][*][p]Reverted the Cacodemon health buff applied in Update 2[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted the Mancubus health and armor buffs applied in Update 2[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted changes to Mancubus Flamethrower damage applied in Update 2[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted changes to Mancubus Fireball speed and size applied in Update 2[/p][/*][*][p](*PT) Chaingunner increased cooldown between burst fire attacks & shortened duration of burst fire attacks[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]🎯Gameplay[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Equipped Guns, upgrades, Melee weapon, and Shield Rune are now retained when reloading checkpoints during the campaign and when transitioning between missions[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Charge AOE (Area of Effect) will now cause health to drop from killed enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Shield Saw could not be raised to perform a Block/Parry during the reload animation of the Super Shotgun [/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to interrupt the Super Shotgun reload animation to melee at the same frame we allow a Block/Parry [/p][/*][*][p]Shortened the delay for the player to interrupt Rocket Launcher and Grenade Launcher firing animations to Shield Block/Parry or Melee [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue introduced in Update 2 that allowed players to potentially switch weapons earlier than intended after firing certain guns including Super Shotgun, Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the brief slowdown experienced after Parrying or using a Melee combo when 'Parry & Melee Slow Down' is set to 0 [/p][/*][*][p]Players will now be restored to a minimum of 75 health upon checkpoint reload if they hit the checkpoint with less health than that amount (this excludes Pandemonium and Ultra Nightmare which don't have checkpoint reloading)[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected an issue where the low ammo notice appears well before the Cycler Plasma Rifle should be notifying for a low ammo state [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the player could briefly become locked out of swapping to the BFC while using the Chainshot [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where upgrading all melee weapons could prevent the Melee Expert and Berserker achievements from completing[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]🛡Weapon Balance[/b][/h1][p align="start"][u][b]Rail Spike Impaler[/b][/u][/p][quote][p][i]Developer Clarification: Impaler headshot damage was not universally increased in Update 2. The approach we took generally favored decreasing Impaler body shot damage in instances where scoring all headshots did not result in a meaningful difference in the total number of shots required to daze or kill a demon. We did increase headshot scaling in a few instances (E.G. Cyberdemon and Whiplash) where reducing body shot damage would have resulted in a longer-than-desired time-to-kill[/i][/p][/quote][list][*][p]Balance adjustments including:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced Impaler damage vs. Cyberdemon[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced headshot scaling of empowered Impaler projectiles (via Salvage and Chronospike upgrades) vs. Whiplash[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced headshot scaling of non-empowered Impaler projectiles vs. Revenant[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]Super Shotgun[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Balance adjustments including:[/p][list][*][p]Increased Super Shotgun damage vs. Hell Knight and Battle Knight [/p][/*][*][p]Increased Super Shotgun damage vs. Cosmic Baron[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted the damage adjustments against Mancubus and its armor applied in Update 2[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Super Shotgun damage vs. Pinky Rider and Armored Pinky Rider [/p][/*][*][p]Increased base Super Shotgun (without upgrades) damage vs. Vagary armor [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1][b]🗺 Levels[/b][/h1][quote][p][i]Active Tunable gameplay refinements are denoted below as: (*AT) for "Active Tunable"[/i][/p][/quote][h3][b]⚔Combat Encounter Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"][u][b]Holy City of Aratum[/b][/u][/p][p align="start"]🗡Final Encounter[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the Hell Knight respawn[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]Siege - Part 1 & Siege - Part 2[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Increased time between maintain spawns in several encounters[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]Siege - Part 2[/b][/u][/p][p align="start"]🗡Courtyard Section[/p][p align="start"](*AT) Fixed an issue where Titan gore collision would disrupt projectiles[/p][p align="start"][u][b]Ancestral Forge[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Resolved issues where additional combat encounters could be triggered erroneously[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🗡Final fight[/p][list][*][p]Removed the Imp and Mancubus maintain support in the Agaddon Hunter intro[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the Arachnotron maintain window[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]Spire of Nerathul[/b][/u][/p][p align="start"]🗡Komodo Boss Fight[/p][list][*][p]Removed the maintain support from the Komodo intro[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🗡Hanging Ship Path[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Arachnotron maintain respawning with inconsistent timing at the end of the encounter[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🗡Overlook Secret[/p][list][*][p]Fixes the Battle Knight maintain occasionally spawning as another enemy AI[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]The Kar’Thul Marshes[/b][/u][/p][p align="start"]🗡Morale fight[/p][list][*][p]Set Nightmare Imp Stalker maintain to begin after both Imp Stalkers are dead, rather than just one[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]Resurrection[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Resolved issues where additional combat encounters could be triggered erroneously[/p][/*][*][p]Added plasma ammo in front of both plasma gates on the Maykr ship[/p][/*][*][p]The “Energy Shield” tutorial pop up does bypass the “Tutorials Off” setting[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][u][b]Final Battle[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Changed the enemy AI composition in the final Atlan encounter so there are fewer armored enemies[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]🎰UI[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Resolved the issue where viewing Newsfeed body content for live tiles displayed a blank pop-up and caused multiple log errors[/p][/*][*][p]Added the 'Energy Shield' popup tutorial to the Pause Menu's tutorial list[/p][/*][*][p]The Energy Shield tutorial in Resurrection will now bypass the "Tutorials Off" setting[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]🏭Engine[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred during Ripatorium Endless mode on Xbox Series X|S & PlayStation 5 when playing for longer than 8 hours continuously[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]If you're still experiencing issues, please holler at our amazing Customer Service team [url="https://help.bethesda.net/#en/home/product/1396"][u]here[/u][/url][/i][/p][/quote][p]
Read all the above in additional languages on Slayers Club [url="https://slayersclub.bethesda.net/en-US/article/doom-the-dark-ages-update-2-1-hotfix-1-release-notes "]here[/url]. [/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.notes: [p]Today's minor update for DOOM: The Dark Ages addresses the following:[/p][list][*][p]Fix for 1-frame jitter that can be caused by resolution scaling[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for VRS (Variable Rate Shading) setting not changing when applying defaults[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p][i]If you're still experiencing issues, please holler at our amazing Customer Service team [u][url="https://help.bethesda.net/#en/home/product/1396"]here[/url][/u][/i][/p]

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes: [p]This update adds the Ripatorium, an endless arena mode that lets players set up their own combat encounters within 3 unique arenas using a simple menu interface. Also included are two new DOOM Slayer skins (see below for unlock criteria), a loopable demo for Benchmark Mode on PC and a slew of other improvements and bug fixes[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uzrP9aoE8VE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]✨New Content  [/h1][p][img notes.title: June 2025 PC Update | Path Tracing (select NVIDIA GPUs) + Benchmark Mode
notes.notes:
[p]This June 2025 PC Update is exclusive to the PC versions of the game. It adds Path Tracing support with Ray Reconstruction for select NVIDIA GPUs. Also included in this update is a brand-new Benchmark Mode that lets PC gamers measure their system’s performance on a variety of settings. Additionally, this update resolves some known issues present in the previous version of the game. 
[/p][previewyoutube="Uf8DQa6VdyU;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]
Path Tracing Support with DLSS Ray Reconstruction[/b][/h2][p]Path Tracing is officially supported on the range of NVIDIA GPUs, video settings and system requirements noted in the table below. Path Tracing, when combined with DLSS Ray Reconstruction adds accurate light bounce modeling, bringing new detail into view on material surfaces and reflections at a level previously not possible in a DOOM game. [/p][p][img src="https://images.mweb.bethesda.net/_images/DoomTheDarkAges_PathTracingHardwareReq_1920x1080-03.jpg?fx=50&fy=50&f=jpg&h=1080&w=1920&s=PGraGhwNo5mLnKsWSZpVNW6Sl5QTUguolxi3EPZ10rI"][/img]Required drivers: [url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/"][u]NVIDIA 576.75 or higher[/u][/url][/p][p]To enable Path Tracing, go to the Video Settings menu, and scroll down to the Path Tracing section and set Path Tracing to On. To enable Ray Reconstruction, select it as the Denoiser in the Path Tracing section of the Video Settings menu. Make sure to apply your settings changes before returning to gameplay. [/p][p][/p][p]While users on other supported GPU models are free to attempt to run the game with Path Tracing enabled at lower settings, 60 FPS, correct visuals and game stability are not assured when doing so. [/p][p][/p][p]Click [url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/doom-the-dark-ages-path-tracing-dlss-ray-reconstruction-update"][u]here[/u][/url] for more information from NVIDIA regarding Path Tracing and the Ray Reconstruction in DOOM: The Dark Ages[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Benchmark Mode [/b][/h2][p]Benchmark mode creates a consistent, nearly deterministic path through a section of select DOOM: The Dark Ages levels to that players can see how their systems perform under a variety of video settings. Using this mode players can see how far they can push their system performance. [/p][p]To access Benchmark Mode, go to the Extras section of the Main Menu and select Benchmark Mode.  From here, you can select and run any of the following Benchmark Levels: 
[img src="https://images.mweb.bethesda.net/_images/image%20(54).png?fx=50&fy=50&f=jpg&h=640&w=772&s=GNUWeYC2-Ev543xefTz0xaVy2SWFRhH-5DPt6s4CMFk"][/img]While running a Benchmark Level, graphs show FPS, total frame time, GPU and CPU frame time. Use the controls listed at the bottom of the screen to toggle graph metrics between FPS and milliseconds, and to toggle graph visibility on/off[/p][p][img src="https://images.mweb.bethesda.net/_images/TDA_Benchmark01.png?fx=50&fy=50&f=jpg&h=2160&w=3840&s=Ibi1x1wY9XlrLTMA2EMCXCqJfiWhA1Tt24Mp8tZmtbM"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h2][p]Resolved an issue in which Alt + Tabbing the game during cutscenes while using FSR Frame Generation on certain NVIDIA GPUS would cause the game to freeze[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Known Issues [/b][/h2][p][i][b]Issue:[/b][/i] Some elements may not appear correctly in the [i]Harbor of Souls[/i] “barge crash” cutscene when running the game in Path Tracing mode in certain hardware and settings configurations[/p][p][i][b]Resolution[/b]:[/i] We are investigating potential fixes for a future update[/p][p][i][b]Issue:[/b][/i] Users with Path Tracing enabled can observe graphical artifacts on tentacle enemies attached to walls[/p][p][i][b]Resolution:[/b][/i] We are investigating potential fixes for a future update[/p]

notes.title: Doom The Dark Ages update fixes one of the worst problems, and makes it tougher
notes.notes:
What does it mean to feel like the Doom Slayer? 2016 and Doom Eternal nailed the energy. With that soundtrack ripping and tearing through your senses, you felt deadly, invincible, and full of righteous rage. But that's no good if you're getting killed every five minutes. You want a challenge. You want to feel as if you're fighting through gritted teeth. But id Software's FPS game also needs fierce momentum - it shouldn't be a stop-start uphill crawl. Between Battlefield 6, Borderlands 4, and Killing Floor 3, we have a lot of good shooters coming up. But if for any reason you've struggled to settle into id's latest, the new Doom The Dark Ages update makes it well worth revisiting.

Read the rest of the story...
